title: イングリッシュトピックス3
subtitle: English Topics 3
courseType:
English Language Program
English Language Courses
educationalGoal: In English Topics 3, students will acquire communication skills in English by studying various topics, English expressions, sentence structures, and vocabulary. They will develop effective language learning techniques of English and acquire the habit of reading extensively. They will also learn and practice presentation skills.
advice: The class will be conducted using the followings topics: Inspire 3 Unit 1 Friendship Unit 2 Fear Unit 3 Health Unit 4 Change Each class consists of active learning activities such as pair work, group work, small projects, and presentations. Students are expected to speak English enthusiastically and cooperate with others. It is necessary to check the e-syllabus and student portal site before each class for homework materials, and listen to the audio files that accompany the textbook. Please bring your textbook and dictionary to every class.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic English grammar and vocabulary are necessary.

activityGoals.body: Listen and understand the overall content of the unit.
Understand the meaning of important vocabulary and expressions in each unit and use them in simple sentences.
Understand and summarize the main points of the text and express them in English, orally or in writing.
Understand basic English grammar and parts of speech and use them appropriately when writing and speaking.
Work collaboratively with classmates to improve English communication skills.
Develop a habit of studying autonomously through extensive reading.

achievementLevels.ideal: - Listen and understand the content of the unit perfectly. - Understand the meaning of important vocabulary and expressions in each unit and can use or apply them appropriately. - Understand the main points of each text and express them in English, orally or in writing. - Understand basic English grammar and parts of speech and use them appropriately when writing and speaking.
achievementLevels.standard: - Listen and understand the overall content of the unit. - Understand the meaning of important vocabulary and expressions in each unit and, though not perfectly, use them to form simple sentences. - Understand and summarize the main points of each text and express them in English, orally or in writing. - Understand the basic English grammar and parts of speech and use them appropriately when writing or speaking.
